title: HelperSSHProbeResult
description: What one credential test answered: an outcome from the closed set, and the classifier's own sentence beside it for the log and for the evidence a settings surface shows. `detail` is a string and not a second enum because it is Rust-from-the-classifier rather than a decision the caller switches on: the outcome is the contract, the sentence is what a person reads.

detail.description: The classifier's sentence — the same one ssh.ClassifyProbeError produces for the coordinator's own probe, so a person reading two paths sees one product.
